reason: Add synthetic read-only administrative and own-account audit views with explicit audit.read and independent domain/clinic grants. Safe five-field projections omit names, contacts, credentials, paths and free-text payloads; linked archival history is preserved, IDs serialize losslessly, and client audit mutations stay denied. Shared optional search/paging/summary presentation and bounded auth-shell sizing preserve existing consumers. No bulk export, erasure, retention, clinical or provider approval is invented.
